svg.title: The atlas traces 24 rule changes since 1870 on four threads: who counts, who governs, who owns and who checks.
svg.desc: A timeline of 24 changes in the rules from 1870 to 2026 on four lanes: who counts, who governs, who owns and who checks. The atlas’s picks bunch in two stretches, seven from 1964 to 1978 and eight from 2010 to 2026, from the Fifteenth Amendment in 1870 to Louisiana v. Callais and Trump v. Slaughter in 2026. Set in Inter and Inter Tight. On a computer without both fonts, the labels fall back to another font and change width.
svg.text: Taft-Hartley Act passed over a veto
